items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Ever since I heard Count Basie's band, I always said he was the best jump band I ever heard... I'd take Basie any time, any place.

ctx.x: No, you're not finished. I'm just finished...
What about Count Basie? What did you think of his band and so forth?
He got the swingiest band anybody ever heard.
